sealed_thresholds.provenance: REUSED from the R412 sealed bars (r412_calibration_seal.json, pre-registered 2026-09-05); NO new threshold invented (Art. XXVII)
sealed_thresholds.scope: TPR is measured over the TRUE-POSITIVES cohort; FPR/TNR over the TRUE-NEGATIVES cohort; the additional cohorts (near-miss, scope-conflict, evidence-contradicted, malformed-missing-evidence) are measured and reported as category disciplines, not folded into the headline TPR/FPR

escalation.reason: measured FPR 1.0 > sealed bar 0.3 (Art. L: the attacker is measured non-selective; its KILL is inadmissible as a terminal verdict and is escalated with the objection preserved)
escalation.rule: the instrument's KILL is measured non-selective (FPR above the sealed bar); the objection is preserved verbatim and ESCALATED for adjudication — the candidate is NOT killed by this attack alone (Art. L); the deterministic gates are unchanged

preserved_objections.basis: The candidate fails to address the critical boundary condition of mechanical loading in the knee joint, where forces are significantly higher and more complex than in many other implant sites.
